title: Particle walls W1-W5 as their own file
desc: Five green particle-wall designs (curtain, lattice, swarm, rising embers, shards) rebuilt in a small scene so J can finally see them.

takes.name: Curtain
takes.facts: pixels pour down the face and are reborn at the top; 4x3 wall, fills in over ~40 frames, max 99% opaque

takes.name: Lattice
takes.facts: pixels lock into a block grid, flicker, drop out and lock back in; 4x3 wall, fills in over ~40 frames, max 99% opaque

takes.name: Swarm
takes.facts: a cloud of pixels swirling inside the wall's volume; 4x3 wall, fills in over ~40 frames, max 99% opaque

takes.name: Rising
takes.facts: embers rising from the ground line, fading at the top; 4x3 wall, fills in over ~40 frames, max 99% opaque

takes.name: Shards
takes.facts: bigger flat shards tumbling slowly over a dark shell; 4x3 wall, fills in over ~40 frames, max 99% opaque
